QuestInfo.name: Delivering the Flying Medicine
QuestInfo.0: It looks like the #t4031079# that will finally fulfill #p407#'s dream is finally ready.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p309##k of #m10002000# asked me to deliver the #t4031079# to #p407#. So this little bottle can make someone fly? I need to get this to #p407# ASAP.
QuestInfo.2: I got #p407# the #t4031079# that #p309# of #m10002000# made. I hope it works for him.

0.0: Okay, I mix this with that, and add that with this, and... okay, I'm done! Here, take it.

yes.0: It's a very rare medicine, so it should only be taken by #p407# and no one else. If you have any desire to take that it for yourself, don't even think about it. It will ONLY work on #p407#.

no.0: What, you don't need it anymore? That's fine with me. Humans are so self-centered and fickle.

1.0: Oh you're back!! Did you meet up with #p309#? What about the medicine? The medicine! Did you bring it?

yes.0: Wow, this is it. This medicine will enable me to fly anywhere I desire and finally realize my dream. Thank you so much for all your help. Here's a little thank you present from me. Hopefully it'll help you down the road. I'll see you around!

npc.0: You haven't given the medicine to #p407# yet? I thought I told you it won't work on anyone else but him, meaning YOU CAN'T FLY WITH IT. Now that you know, go see #p407# immediately and give him the medicine, all right?
